README.md.description: Repository overview, directory layout, metadata rules, and manifest workflow instructions.

config/file-metadata.json.description: Authoritative repository-relative file descriptions required for manifest generation.

src/generate-manifest.js.description: Validates descriptive metadata and generates the tracked-file inventory manifest.

.github/workflows/update-manifest.yml.description: GitHub Actions workflow that regenerates and commits the repository manifest.

src/issue-command.js.description: Executes validated repository commands and scoped Issue #1 comment deletion with target verification; returns structured results without publishing.

src/render-command.js.description: Renders local file contents and compact GitHub commit receipts (SHA and verified flag), suppressing raw API response JSON.

src/command-parser.js.description: Parses commands, appends UTF-8 decoded source previews to original comments at submission, and avoids edit-triggered replay.

src/command-runner.js.description: Executes one source-comment command and checks its nonce marker in that same comment to prevent replay without creating claim comments.

.github/workflows/commandline-issue.yml.description: Routes authorized issue comments through parser and runner, with a fallback GitHub token and repository content/issue permissions.

src/command-catalog.json.description: Imported GitHub operation catalog used by command executor.

src/publish-results.js.description: Queues and renders command results, appending them to the originating issue comment by PATCH instead of creating response comments.

src/command-workflow.js.description: Workflow coordinator invokes one runner process per ordinal nonce and accumulates each result.

workspaces/api-to-nodejs/README.md.description: Defines the isolated project scope, acceptance criteria, and constraints for converting GitHub API commands to Node.js execution.

workspaces/api-to-nodejs/PROJECT_INSTRUC.description: Project-specific agent instructions covering the GitHub Issues command terminal, command discovery, workspace isolation, and Node.js conversion workflow.

workspaces/api-to-nodejs/local-repositor.description: Workspace-only Node.js filesystem/Git adapter for safe repository content and README reads.
Node.js fixture tests for local content mapping and rejection cases.

workspaces/api-to-nodejs/API_MAPPING.md.description: Inventory of API calls, local equivalents, remote-only gaps, and validation status.

src/direct-parser.js.description: Validates owner-authored direct execution comments and constructs source, dependency, argument, and return envelopes.

src/direct-runner.js.description: Runs direct JavaScript with dependencies inside a temporary Node.js environment and emits a result receipt.

workspaces/api-to-nodejs/direct-node-exe.description: Staged reusable container execution and separate result publication workflow.

workspaces/api-to-nodejs/commandline-iss.description: Staged direct-tag job for incorporation into the main Issue listener workflow.

AGENTS.md.description: Root agent bootstrap instructions: discover the command terminal by exact Issue title through GitHub integration Issue operations, submit commands, and fetch same-comment receipts.
